de.abas.erp.db

Interface Worker<T,RESULT>

  • Type Parameters:
    T - Processing object type
    RESULT - Result type. May be Void

    public interface Worker<T,RESULT>
    A worker that processes an object of type T an produces a result of type RESULT

    Example:

    Query<Customer> queryDesc = getContext().createQuery(selection); List<BigDecimal> result = queryDesc.execute(new Worker<Customer, BigDecimal>() { public Integer process(Customer item) { return Integer.valueOf(item.getTurnoFY()); } });
